Team and Carlos — triage update and immediate remediation steps below.

What we see so far:
- Error spike correlates with a backend upgrade in one of our shard pools at ~02:55 UTC (kernel change queued during a rolling update). Some instances fell back to a slower execution path causing KV cache churn and elevated p99 latencies.
- Impact window (observed): 02:55:12 UTC — 05:41:03 UTC. We will refine with Carlos' access to full request logs.

Immediate mitigations executed (completed):
- Forced traffic off the updated shard pool and routed to warm standby (rebalanced in 7m).
- Disabled speculative batching (reduces KV churn) and set max_batch_size=8 for affected routes.
- Restarted affected instances with previous kernel build; error rate is trending down.

Pending actions (next 6 hours):
- Full root cause RCA (including kernel changes, rollout cadence, and canary thresholds).
- We'll prepare a compact remediation summary and a replayable test case.
- I need S3 links to StellarNet's request traces for the impacted window (Carlos — see requested IAM role in a follow-up).

Attachments: network-trace.zip (collected traces), runbook excerpt for rollback commands.

Monica Patel
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Carlos — thank you again for the samples and for arranging access. Quick summary and proposed path forward:

Technical summary (from Monica):
- Root cause: an automated kernel rollout created a performance regression for a subset of shard instances, causing KV cache churn and higher per-token latency.
- Impact window we currently estimate: 2027-05-18 02:55:12 UTC — 2027-05-18 05:41:03 UTC (Monica will validate once traces are ingested).
- Immediate fix: rolled back the kernel on affected nodes, forced traffic to standby, and adjusted batching; service metrics are returning to baseline.

Commercial remediation (proposed):
- We propose a two-part remediation: (1) pro-rata credit for token usage during the confirmed impact window, and (2) a one-time goodwill credit of 5% of the impacted invoice to recognize broader operational disruption.
- Marcus will model exact amounts once Monica confirms token counts. We can expedite a DocuSign amendment for quick acceptance.

Next steps / timeline:
- Monica: finalize impact token count and RCA draft by 10:00 UTC (today).
- Marcus: prepare credit estimate and DocuSign draft by 12:00 UTC.
- Exec sync proposal: 14:00 UTC — Carlos, please confirm if that works for your team; Jonas and I will join.

Attachments: redwood_remedy_summary.pdf (summary and proposed credit options).

We appreciate your patience; we'll make this right and share the detailed RCA and credit calculation shortly.
